claim: Which two second growths are known as the 'Super Seconds' of Saint-Julien's Léoville trio? ... Léoville-Las-Cases and Léoville-Barton
because: The canonical super-second list (Wine Spectator glossary: Cos d'Estournel, Ducru-Beaucaillou, Léoville Las Cases, Palmer, Pichon Lalande) names only one Léoville, Las Cases. Barton and Poyferré are both only sometimes added, so a candidate answering Las Cases and Poyferré is as defensible as Las Cases and Barton; the stem's 'two' has no single right answer.
fix: Stem: Which Léoville is the Saint-Julien estate classically counted among the 'Super Seconds'? Answer: Léoville-Las-Cases (Barton and Poyferré are sometimes added). Accept: ['leoville las cases', 'las cases']
